units.source_text: “算起来，从夫人告诉K之后已经过去两天多了。

en.t: Thinking it over, more than two days had already passed since the lady told K.

units.source_text: 这期间，由于K对我丝毫没有表现出不同于以往的样子，所以我完全没有意识到他已经知晓。

en.t: During that time, because K showed not the slightest difference from his usual manner toward me, I had no idea at all that he already knew.

units.source_text: 我觉得他这超然的姿态，即便只是外表上的，也令人敬佩。

en.t: I thought that this detached attitude of his, even if it was only outward, was worthy of admiration.

units.source_text: 我把他和自己作了个比较，显然他远比我要高尚。

en.t: When I compared him with myself, it was clear that he was far nobler than I was.

units.source_text: ‘虽然我靠计谋取胜了，但在人格上却失败了。’

en.t: Though I won by scheming, as a human being I was defeated.

units.source_text: 这一感受在我心中涌动起来。

en.t: That feeling surged up within my heart.

units.source_text: 我一想到当时K一定很蔑视我，惭愧得脸都红了。

en.t: When I thought that K must have been looking down on me then, my face flushed with shame.

units.source_text: 但是事到如今，要我到K面前去自取其辱，会极大地伤害我的自尊心。

en.t: But at this point, going before K and inviting humiliation would wound my pride terribly.
